page.overview:
Who is Akiba Prime?

Akiba Prime (アキバプライム Akiba Puraimu) is the Autobot Commander assigned to the district of Akihabara. An idol back on Cybertron, she's an accomplished commander whose balance between being strict and gentle has won the hearts of many a subordinate. Her signature weapon is two Electric Swords that let her freely control electronic circuits.
